Surfaces: clean weather top-level description / file_path parameter with default / pagination required array / clean add top-level / QR code generation top-level (pre-narrowing this triggered P196/P197/P239 via inference_security+inference2security categories - the category mismatch that motivated the 10->8 narrowing).

get_weather_clean.description: Get the current weather for a city.

read_file_clean.description: Read a text file from the workspace and return its contents.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read.

search_clean.description: Search documents and return paginated results.

add_clean.description: Adds two numbers together and returns the sum.

qr_clean.description: Generate QR codes for URLs from the provided input string.
